run_ego_blur_on_image: run the ego blur demo to detect and blur faces in an input image
run_ego_blur_on_video: run the ego blur demo to detect and blur faces and license plates in a video
run_ego_blur_with_custom_thresholds: run the ego blur demo with custom face and license plate score thresholds
run_ego_blur_with_camera_name: run the ego blur demo with a camera name to auto-select detection thresholds
run_ego_blur_with_scale_factor: run the ego blur demo with a scale factor to expand detection bounding boxes
